description: This file is a C header file defining function declarations for helper functions that interact with a properties service. It provides mechanisms to query, retrieve, and set properties of various types (string, int, bool, etc.), along with event handling related to property changes. The file includes licensing information, include guards, and references to external dependencies.

methods.name: hasProperty
methods.description: Checks if a specific property is set in the properties service.

methods.name: canServerSetProperty
methods.description: Checks if a property can be changed remotely by server or XConf.

methods.name: getPropertyAsString
methods.description: Retrieves a property as a string, with a default fallback.

methods.name: getPropertyEventAsString
methods.description: Gets the string value from a property change event.

methods.name: getPropertyAsInt32
methods.description: Retrieves a property as a 32-bit signed integer, with a default.

methods.name: getPropertyEventAsInt32
methods.description: Gets a 32-bit signed integer from a property change event.

methods.name: getPropertyAsUInt32
methods.description: Retrieves a property as a 32-bit unsigned integer, with a default.

methods.name: getPropertyEventAsUInt32
methods.description: Gets a 32-bit unsigned integer from a property change event.

methods.name: getPropertyAsInt64
methods.description: Retrieves a property as a 64-bit signed integer, with a default.

methods.name: getPropertyEventAsInt64
methods.description: Gets a 64-bit signed integer from a property change event.

methods.name: getPropertyAsUInt64
methods.description: Retrieves a property as a 64-bit unsigned integer, with a default.

methods.name: getPropertyEventAsUInt64
methods.description: Gets a 64-bit unsigned integer from a property change event.

methods.name: getPropertyAsBool
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean property, defaulting if unavailable.

methods.name: getPropertyEventAsBool
methods.description: Gets a boolean value from a property change event.

methods.name: setPropertyValue
methods.description: Sets a property value, with options for overwriting and priority source.

methods.name: setPropertyUInt32
methods.description: Sets a 32-bit unsigned integer property.

methods.name: setPropertyInt32
methods.description: Sets a 32-bit signed integer property.

methods.name: setPropertyUInt64
methods.description: Sets a 64-bit unsigned integer property.

methods.name: setPropertyInt64
methods.description: Sets a 64-bit signed integer property.

methods.name: setPropertyBool
methods.description: Sets a boolean property.
